# Vendored JavaScript

`chart.js` is the unmodified Chart.js 4.5.1 UMD distribution, used by the admin
usage charts and served locally through Sprockets and importmap.

- Source: <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js>
- License: MIT; see `chart.LICENSE.md`.
- SHA-384 in base64: `jb8JQMbMoBUzgWatfe6COACi2ljcDdZQ2OxczGA3bGNeWe+6DChMTBJemed7ZnvJ`

When updating, review upstream changes, replace the distribution and license,
update this record, and run the admin browser tests and asset build.
